item.text: The deadlock is in worker coordination: a callback panic unwinds one worker while peers keep waiting for work, and `join().unwrap()` is reached only after they finish. I’m changing worker threads to catch panics, signal global shutdown, join every worker, then rethrow the original panic; worker construction remains in the caller thread so builder panics cannot strand already-running workers.

{\\n            let handles: Vec<_> = workers\\n                .into_iter()\\n                .map(|worker| {\\n                    let quit_now = quit_now.clone();\\n                    s.spawn(move || {\\n                        let result = std::panic::catch_unwind(\\n                            std::panic::AssertUnwindSafe(|| worker.run()),\\n                        );\\n                        if let Err(payload) = result {\\n                            quit_now.store(true, AtomicOrdering::SeqCst);\\n                            Err(payload)\\n                        } else {\\n item.text:
Implemented the `ignore` crate fix in [walk.rs](~/.bench-runs/A3-ripgrep__gpt-6-astra__r1/repo/crates/ignore/src/walk.rs):

- Worker panics now signal all workers to stop, allowing every thread to join safely.
- The original panic is rethrown to the caller.
- Visitor builders are created before worker threads start, so builder panics cannot strand workers.
- Added regression tests for panics in both visitor callbacks and visitor builders.

Verification:

- `timeout 60 cargo test -p ignore`
- All 147 unit tests, integration tests, and doctests passed.
